intent: P7 Sprint 2 batch implements UTIL 5-table schema + 综合能耗 service (per P7-OPEN-009 + D1 裁决 1A). Adds 5 new tables (T0 CONFIG + T1/T2/T3 utility sub-types + T5 summary), T4 ALTER util_results 4 字段, T5 service 聚合 T1+T2+T3 + ConfigEnergyConversionFactor 折标 + ≤2% tolerance check, 8 new API endpoints + G-08 baseline roll.
peer_coverage: Adversarial lens ran via in-process adversarial-reviewer (no codex CLI available).

primary_findings.title: T5 service steam/water toe_factor unit ambiguity — totals may be 1000x wrong
evidence: pcs-backend/app/services/util/utility_energy_summary_service.py:167 — `agg.steam_t_yr * s_toe` multiplies TONNES by toe_factor 0.0760 (per kg in config model docstring; service treats as per-tonne)

Golden fixture Case 1: 20000 t × 0.0760 = 1520 kg — only correct if factor is per-tonne, not per-kg. Either model docstring or service is wrong; fixture follows service. Tests pass either way (wrong-on-both-sides).
primary_findings.suggested_fix: Pick one: (A) Update ConfigEnergyConversionFactor docstring + seed comment to say steam/water toe_factor is per-tonne (matches service math). (B) Service: change to `agg.steam_t_yr * 1000 * s_toe` (and `* 1000 * w_toe` for water) and recompute golden fixture. Confirm with 工艺室 which unit GB/T 50441 appendix uses.

primary_findings.title: T5 summarize_energy_year TOCTOU race — concurrent POSTs return 500
evidence: utility_energy_summary_service.py:245-296 — non-locking SELECT then INSERT-or-UPDATE branch without `for_update()` or transaction wrap

Two concurrent POSTs to /api/v1/util/energy-summary/aggregate for same (project_id, business_year, source) both pass SELECT, both fall into 'new' branch, both call db.add(); second commit trips UNIQUE(project_id, business_year, source) → 500.
primary_findings.suggested_fix: Use `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (project_id, business_year, source) DO UPDATE SET ...` raw PG SQL (asyncpg upsert), OR catch IntegrityError and re-apply UPDATE branch.

primary_findings.title: tolerance_pct guard raises TypeError when xls_reference.total_toe is None
evidence: utility_energy_summary_service.py:236 — `if xls_reference is not None and xls_reference.total_toe > 0:`
primary_findings.suggested_fix: Replace `and xls_reference.total_toe > 0` with `and xls_reference.total_toe is not None and xls_reference.total_toe > 0`.

primary_findings.title: tolerance_status server_default='OK' silently masks 'never computed' — false-negative compliance audits
primary_findings.suggested_fix: Drop server_default (force explicit assignment in service) OR change to 'NA'. Add CHECK: tolerance_status='OK' ⇒ tolerance_pct IS NOT NULL AND tolerance_pct <= 2.0.

primary_findings.title: annual_consumption override accepted without plausibility check — silent data integrity drift
evidence: app/schemas/util.py:115-117, 157-159, 206-208 — annual_consumption fields are user-overridable with only ge=0
app/services/util/utility_energy_summary_service.py:70-99 — derived formula bypassed if client overrides
primary_findings.suggested_fix: Reject client override in T1/T2/T3 schema (only server-side derives); OR add plausibility check (annual_consumption <= motor_power × 8760).

primary_findings.title: 5-min TTL cache for ConfigEnergyConversionFactor not implemented — repeated DB queries + stale config risk
evidence: utility_energy_summary_service.py:102-113 — `_get_energy_conversion_factors` reads ConfigEnergyConversionFactor on every call; no caching
primary_findings.suggested_fix: Implement 5-min TTL cache (仿 _compound_config_cache.py 模式) before T7 release.

primary_findings.title: T5 service ignores business_year when aggregating T1/T2/T3 — multi-year data silently mixed
evidence: utility_energy_summary_service.py:62-68 — `business_year 当前未用于过滤 (T1/T2/T3 表无 year 字段; 数据为 project snapshot)`
primary_findings.suggested_fix: Add business_year to T1/T2/T3 subtables OR enforce single-year-per-project invariant. Document snapshot semantics.

primary_findings.title: T5 service falls back to hardcoded defaults when ConfigEnergyConversionFactor row missing — silent data drift
evidence: utility_energy_summary_service.py:102-113, 154-159 — `_get_energy_conversion_factors` returns dict; service uses `factors.get(energy_type, (0.1229, 0.4040))` — silent fallback
primary_findings.suggested_fix: Raise if missing factors; require all 6 energy_type rows seeded before summary can compute. Surface ConfigurationError to API caller.

primary_findings.title: No project/workspace access control — ACL is role-only; any DESIGNER reads/writes any project
evidence: app/api/v1/util.py:411-430, 476-495, 542-561, 594-621, 380-408 — all 8 new endpoints accept arbitrary project_id/workspace_id
app/api/v1/config.py:88-98 (require_roles) + 441-469 (current_actor) — role gate only, no project membership check
primary_findings.suggested_fix: Out of Sprint 2 scope; flag for P7-7+ UserProject/WorkspaceMember model + per-project ACL check. Pre-existing across PCS backend.

primary_findings.title: func.now() ORM-set may fail on SQLite for idempotent UPDATE
evidence: utility_energy_summary_service.py:270 — `existing.computed_at = func.now()` ORM-set explicit; column already has onupdate=func.now()
primary_findings.suggested_fix: Remove explicit assignment and rely on existing `onupdate=func.now()` (model util.py:489 already has it).

primary_findings.title: UtilResultsResponse missing 4 new aggregator columns — undocumented schema decision
evidence: app/schemas/util.py:35-47 — UtilResultsResponse lacks 4 new util_results columns (electrical_power_kwh_yr, fuel_gas_consumption_nm3_yr, steam_consumption_t_yr, cooling_water_consumption_t_yr)
T4 migration adds 4 columns but they're not exposed via API
primary_findings.suggested_fix: Document in SPEC V1.4.1: 4 columns are aggregator-output-only (written by T5 service, consumed via utility_energy_summary API, not via UtilResultsResponse). OR add to schema if consumers need raw read.

primary_findings.title: T0 seed script runs out-of-band of alembic — deployer may forget, masking factor source-of-truth
primary_findings.suggested_fix: Fold seed into follow-up migration `p7_open_009_t0b_seed_*` for reproducibility.

primary_findings.title: Enum-like string fields (source/fuel_type/temperature_class/operating_phase) accept arbitrary values — no Literal validation
T5 service writes water_t_yr / gas_nm3_yr / low_temp_heat_gj_yr as 0.0 even though nullable
tolerance_status default conflict: ORM server_default='OK' but service initial value is 'NA'
_compute_totals hardcoded unit constants (KWH_TO_MJ, NM3_FUEL_GAS_TO_MJ, T_STEAM_TO_MJ) bypass CONFIG-table pattern
T4 ALTER adds 4 columns without NOT VALID — full table scan + ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
No rate limit on /energy-summary/aggregate — DOS via repeat click
aggregate_energy_summary hardcodes source='CALCULATION' — no API path for XLS_REFERENCE rows
T4 does not backfill util_results.consumption_json → 4 new columns for Sprint 1 historical data
equipment_id FK to equipment_list nullable + ondelete SET NULL — silent decoupling when equipment deleted
JWT role default permissive (DESIGNER lowest privilege) — ACL depends on JWT issuer integrity
Migrations lack IF NOT EXISTS for create_table — partial-apply recovery requires manual alembic downgrade -1
CASCADE on workspace_id FK — workspace deletion silently destroys 5-table data
